purpose: Small source/context implementation targets for W4.2-W4.6; no provider outcomes or final measurement freeze.
answer_contract: exact_json_facts_v1; answers, context, relationship expectations and labels are evaluator-only.

source_coverage_policy.declarations: Exact complete authored declaration bodies, excluding surrounding whitespace/export modifiers; variable bindings use the complete declarator without const/let/var or its final statement semicolon. Internal bytes, members, as-const assertions and heritage clauses are retained.
source_coverage_policy.linkage: Exact imports and re-export statements retain all tokens; direct callee export headers are separate required spans in endpoint controls.
source_coverage_policy.task_relevance: The full outer input declarations and type-alias linkage remain conservative requirements; the unused BrainCompiledEvidence members are excluded only from anvil_retrieval_limits.
source_coverage_policy.matching: Exact original file and byte intervals; no token similarity, name-only matching or source normalization at scoring time.
source_coverage_policy.signatures: Credit each exact source-bearing signature only within its identified indexed declaration. Transformed/noncontiguous signatures remain metadata without source credit; complete output bytes still count.
source_coverage_policy.go: Complete authored type_spec/type_alias excludes the enclosing shared type keyword; keep alias equals sign, arguments, constraints, bodies and embedding.

retained_controls.policy: Preserve all old inputs and outcomes; do not pool historical measurements with future multilingual runs.

provenance.limit: One complete maintained module, not a full-repository or code-edit benchmark.
